data.one_liner: Detects if a device is currently in the lock screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to check whether the mobile device is currently locked. It helps distinguish whether an app entered the background because the user locked the screen or because they navigated away from the app.
use_when: You need to know if the app went to the background due to a device lock.
You want to handle app lifecycle security logic depending on lock status.
avoid_when: You are running tests or running iOS on a simulator (iOS detection only works on physical devices).
You need complex hardware button event streaming.
strengths: Avoids using non-public APIs on iOS to comply with App Store requirements.
weaknesses: iOS detection relies on screen brightness checking and only works on physical devices.
No stream-based listening out of the box, requires manual polling via lifecycle observers.
